en: Core sales rose 19% to $5.08B and core EPS of $0.91 beat the $0.88 consensus, both above Corning's own range. Optical Communications grew 44% to $2.38B, with Enterprise Networks up 84% and generative AI products more than doubling, and core operating margin rose 310 bp to 22.7%. The Q4 guide of $5.2–5.3B and $0.96–1.00 topped the $0.93 EPS consensus, a run rate near $21B. CEO Wendell Weeks said growth is accelerating; CFO Ed Schlesinger stressed long-term deals that share expansion costs.

Shares traded about 3% lower before the open, near $124, as investors weighed heavy capex, GAAP sales that trailed some estimates and a Solar ramp running slower than planned. They swung between $121.75 and $128.48 during the session and closed 1.1% lower at $126.30, after an 8% drop on Oct 22 in a broad chip selloff. Truist trimmed its target to $175 on valuation even as it raised its estimates.
zh: 核心销售增长 19% 至 50.8 亿美元，核心每股收益 0.91 美元高于 0.88 美元的市场预期，均超出公司自身指引。光通信增长 44% 至 23.8 亿美元，其中企业网络增长 84%，生成式 AI 产品增长逾一倍；核心营业利润率提升 310 基点至 22.7%。第四季指引为 52–53 亿美元、每股 0.96–1.00 美元，高于 0.93 美元的每股预期，年化约 210 亿美元。CEO 温德尔·威克斯表示增长正在加速；CFO 埃德·施莱辛格强调长期协议由客户分担扩产成本。
开盘前股价下跌约 3% 至约 124 美元，投资者顾虑高额资本开支、GAAP 销售低于部分预期，以及太阳能爬坡慢于计划。盘中在 121.75 至 128.48 美元之间震荡，收跌 1.1% 至 126.30 美元；此前 10 月 22 日已在芯片股普跌中下跌 8%。Truist 虽上调盈利预测，但因估值将目标价下调至 175 美元。

bio.en: Joined Corning in 1983 and has been CEO since 2005 and chairman since 2007. Championed Gorilla Glass for smartphones and now the optical-fiber build-out for AI data centers under the Springboard plan.
bio.zh: 1983 年加入康宁，2005 年起任 CEO，2007 年兼任董事长。曾力推智能手机用大猩猩玻璃，目前在 Springboard 计划下主导面向 AI 数据中心的光纤扩产。

bio.en: CFO since February 2022. Joined Corning in 2013 as CFO of the Optical Communications segment and was corporate controller from 2015, after more than 20 years in finance roles elsewhere.
bio.zh: 2022 年 2 月起任 CFO。2013 年加入康宁任光通信事业部 CFO，2015 年起任公司财务总监，此前在其他公司从事财务工作二十多年。
